text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. To think I'd run into
familiar faces in a place like this.
Did you two come to offer a prayer together?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hello.
I'm not here to pray today, actually—
I came to do some volunteer cleaning.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Cleaning up was so much fun!
Tachyon, you really should've joined in too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
...By the way, Tachyon,
why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A tea specialty shop I'm fond of is nearby.
In short, I'm on my way back from shopping.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to treat you all as well,
but I haven't mixed the concoction yet, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you blended these tea leaves yourself?
How wonderful...
I would love to have a taste.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... To think three test subjects
would gather at once...
Very well, I shall gladly treat you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... I've already concocted a batch, so I'll get it ready as soon as we return to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! A tea party after so long!
I'll be looking forward to the invitation!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You really don't have to be so formal.
If we're doing it at the academy, even without invitations,
as long as we keep in touch—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No... it's true, we probably do need some rules and guidance.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, I'd like to know your health status
in advance. I shall prepare a few questions.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Health condition...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My... thank you very much
for your thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, it's necessary.
It affects your progress after drinking it.
If numbness sets in, you'd be in trouble too, wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Numbness...??

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any particular allergies~!
Ah, and no need to test it for poison, either.
I love both my ramen and my tea piping hot☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha, rest assured!
It might give you an uncontrollable fit of laughter,
but it certainly isn't poison!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. A tea party filled with nonstop laughter...
Sounds like it will be a wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(...What's going on? It feels like we've been
talking past each other for a while now...!)
